fact_checks.sentence: Dans la grotte de la Font Major, en Catalogne, 280 gravures remontant à l’Âge de glace ont été redécouvertes.
source_passages: BY-SA The third-largest collection of Ice Age-era engravings ever found on Spain’s Mediterranean side was sitting in plain sight where visitors for centuries had been walking right by them.

In extreme contrast, Font Major contains 280, among which 55 separate animals are documented, including horses, wild oxen, bears, goats, and deer—”a transformational discovery” for the understanding of Paleolithic European art, the statement read.

A statement on the discovery details that people have been visiting the cave, called Cova de la Font Major, in Catalonia since the 12th century.
From 1957 onwards it was widely frequented by visitors, spelunkers, and treasure hunters and it was even converted into a tourist attraction with a museum in 1993.

positive_change.result: Le contrôle ciblé de la lamproie marine dans les Grands Lacs limite son impact sur les populations locales de poissons commerciaux.
positive_change.beneficiaries: Les espèces de poissons commerciales comme la truite, le corégone, la perche et l'esturgeon dans les Grands Lacs.

fact_checks.sentence: Introduite au XIXe siècle dans les Grands Lacs via le canal Welland, la lamproie marine a gravement perturbé les écosystèmes aquatiques en s'attaquant notamment aux truites et autres poissons d'intérêt commercial.
source_passages: Sea lampreys invaded the Great Lakes in the 1830s via the Welland Canal, which connects Lakes America and Erie and forms a key section of the St.
Within a decade, they had gained access to all five Great Lakes, where they quickly set to work predating on the lakes' commercially important fishes, including trout, whitefish, perch, and sturgeon.
Within a century, the trout fishery had collapsed, largely due to the lamprey's unchecked proliferation.

fact_checks.sentence: Depuis plusieurs décennies, la Commission des pêcheries des Grands Lacs pilote des actions coordonnées entre le Service des pêches des États-Unis et Pêches et Océans Canada pour maîtriser cette espèce invasive.
source_passages: Today, the Great Lakes Fishery Commission coordinates control of sea lampreys in the lakes, which is conducted by the U.S.
Fish and Wildlife Service and Fisheries and Oceans Canada.

fact_checks.sentence: Ces mesures consistent en la pose de barrières et de pièges dans les ruisseaux où la lamproie remonte frayer, ainsi que l'emploi de lampricides qui détruisent les larves sans nuire aux autres formes de vie aquatique.
source_passages: Field biologists set up barriers and traps in the streams that feed the lakes to prevent the lamprey's upstream movements, and apply special chemicals, called lampricides, that target lamprey larvae but are harmless to other aquatic creatures.

fact_checks.sentence: En approfondissant la connaissance du comportement de la lamproie, notamment son usage des phéromones pour la communication, les chercheurs développent de nouvelles techniques destinées à parfaire ces contrôles.
source_passages: Since sea lampreys use odors, or pheromones, to communicate, scientists have replicated these odors to increase the efficacy of current control methods.

fact_checks.sentence: Ainsi, les populations de poissons des Grands Lacs bénéficient d'une régulation plus efficace de ce parasite ancien.
